title: Health Promotion and Education
topics: Nature and scope of health promotion

items.q: Which statement correctly defines Behaviour?
o: the duty to keep personal information private except with consent or legal requirement
an action a person performs that can be observed and repeated
the process of enabling people to increase control over and improve their own wellbeing
the planned use of messages and channels to inform and influence decisions about wellbeing
items.s: Behaviour: an action a person performs that can be observed and repeated. The other options describe Confidentiality, Health promotion, Health communication.

items.q: All of the following belong to Behaviour and behaviour change EXCEPT
o: Predisposing factor
Lecture method
Behaviour
Enabling factor
items.s: Every other option belongs to Behaviour and behaviour change. “Lecture method” belongs to Health literacy and education methods, not Behaviour and behaviour change.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines Cue to action?

legal and environmental measures that shield the public from known hazards
items.s: Cue to action: an event or message that finally pushes a person to act on an intention. The other options describe Health protection, Focus group discussion, Audience segmentation.
